notes: The source is used as a mechanic reference only. Collision Chimes is an original self-contained transformation: the board geometry, target wall-event sequence, seeded configurations, palette, interface, animation, sound-free visual feedback, input transcript, grader, verifier, and solver are newly implemented. No source images, audio, fonts, code, or branding are shipped. Sound is optional in the source and is not authoritative here; visible wall flashes are the only graded feedback.
